name: Provoke
rule_excerpt:
**Provoke** (`guard.provoke`). *"While you hold Guard, the first foe each round whose blow your plates soak is Taunted
by you for {=numbers.rounds} round, with no save (a Boss too: it is never forced, but it is worse at hitting anyone
else)."*
- Fields: `rounds: 1`; limit `per_round` n 1. Why: one free Taunt a round is Challenge's price (1 AP, 1 Guard) saved
  once a round; two a round would leave Challenge with no job.
- Runs on: plates (it fires only on a soak). Carrier: trigger `taking`, `if {target: self, actor: foe, by_hit: true,
  self_has_res: [guard]}`, op `condition taunted target: actor skip_save rounds`.
- Bulwark: its Challenge (with Draw Fire merged, section 4) taunts on its turn; Provoke taunts on theirs. Perks: Answer
  in Kind (hurt → damage) and Weight of the Wall stack with it, no overlap. Peak: no.
- Excite: walk into the gunline holding plates; the first rifleman to fire at you is stuck on you while your squad
  flanks him.

prompt:
Create ONE original flat WHITE #FFFFFF ink RPG icon on a fully TRANSPARENT backdrop. Match the attached references' confident hand-inked silhouettes and broad transparent interior cuts. No gray, shading, gradients, glow, texture, opaque black paint, text, numerals, frame or border. All gaps, including screen dark areas, must be transparent. Center the whole compact action in a generous 15% transparent margin, square 1024x1024 composition. Readable at 32/44px (condition signs also at24/48px). CAST: exactly the approved Wick, the small CERAMIC AUTOMATON with oversized chamfered rectangular head, inset 8-BIT PIXEL-SCREEN expression, small ear discs and offset fasteners, chunky mitten hands/boots, short ASYMMETRIC CAPELET, and visible round LANTERN HEART with thick equal cross arms. About 2.4 heads tall, no human face, no literal flame-head. ONE full Wick maximum; others are cropped partials. Keep cape wedge and heart readable. The cup/bowl and floating arrows in Mind Without Fog belong ONLY to that trait, NOT this icon. No default cup, saucer, head halo, reference corner star or decorative arrows. 
PAINT: Wick leans forward behind ONE curved chest plate, beckoning with the free hand as ONE short incoming dart stops on the plate. Cocky pixel smirk: soaking the first blow draws attention back to him. A cropped opposing forearm only at the far edge.
AVOID: No giant shield, extra full person, floating default arrows or aggression marks over an ally.
